hero.subtitle: A free live webinar for caregivers navigating the ripple effect when one child's needs pull focus from the rest of the family.
hero.description:
When one child requires more emotional attention and support, the entire family system can feel the impact.

This training helps caregivers navigate sibling dynamics, summer overwhelm, guilt, resentment, and emotional exhaustion while still creating connection, balance, and safety for every child in the home.

countdown.heading: The live session begins in
countdown.live: We're live now. Come on in.
countdown.ended: This session has ended. Register to get the replay.

forYou.heading: This is for you if...
items: One child's needs are pulling most of your time and energy, and you feel it straining everyone else.
You feel guilty no matter what you do, for the child who needs more and for the ones who get less.
Summer's lack of structure has pushed everyone's stress to a breaking point.
You want practical tools to protect connection with every child in the home, not just the one in crisis.

learn.heading: What you'll walk away with
items: How to navigate sibling dynamics without picking sides or playing referee.
Ways to ease summer overwhelm and rebuild a sense of family rhythm.
How to work through guilt and resentment before they quietly build up.
Practical strategies to protect connection, balance, and safety for every child in the home.

guide.name: Bryan Post
guide.bio: Bryan Post is an internationally recognized expert in adoption, attachment, and trauma, and the founder of the love-based, family-centered approach behind our program. For decades he has helped families move from fear and conflict toward connection, calm, and lasting healing.

trust.heading: Why families trust this webinar
trust.audience: Join adoptive and foster families from across California, supported by the Fear to Love methodology and the Love Pathways Wraparound team.
